list.name: Model Retrained
list.rawQuery: SELECT extract(epoch from created_at)*1000 AS time, annotation_text AS text, tags FROM model_annotations WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Input drift — home_odds mean vs training baseline
panels.description: Numerical feature. Serving mean of home_odds per 5-min window compared to the champion's training baseline mean.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '5m'), avg((input_data::json->>'home_odds')::float) AS serving_mean, (SELECT value FROM training_feature_stats WHERE is_baseline AND feature_name='home_odds' AND metric='mean' LIMIT 1) AS baseline_mean FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Input drift — favorite=HOME frequency vs baseline
panels.description: Categorical feature (cheapest-odds outcome). Serving frequency of HOME favorite per 10-min window vs training baseline frequency.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '10m'), avg(CASE WHEN (input_data::json->>'home_odds')::float <= (input_data::json->>'draw_odds')::float AND (input_data::json->>'home_odds')::float <= (input_data::json->>'away_odds')::float THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS serving_home_fav_freq, (SELECT value FROM training_feature_stats WHERE is_baseline AND feature_name='favorite' AND category='HOME' AND metric='freq' LIMIT 1) AS baseline_home_fav_freq FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Prediction behavior — home-win rate over time
panels.description: Mean predicted class per 5-min window. A flat line at 0 or 1 indicates the model is stuck on one class.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '5m'), avg(prediction) AS home_win_rate FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Prediction behavior — class counts over time
panels.description: Number of predicted home-wins vs non-home-wins per 5-min window (stacked).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '5m'), sum(CASE WHEN prediction >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS predicted_home_win, sum(CASE WHEN prediction < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS predicted_other FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Prediction confidence — mean P(home win) by model version
panels.description: Average predicted probability per 5-min window, split by model version so behavior before/after retraining is visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '5m'), model_version AS metric, avg(proba_home_win) AS confidence FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND proba_home_win IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, model_version ORDER BY 1
